description: This source file defines a remote commit service interface and its implementation for transaction handling in Orleans. It includes classes for different transaction commit operations with serialization attributes.

classes.name: RemoteCommitService
classes.description: Implementation of a remote commit service that logs transaction results and simulates operation delays.

classes.name: PassOperation
classes.description: Represents a successful commit operation with data payload, implements transaction commit logic via service.

classes.name: FailOperation
classes.description: Represents a failed commit operation with data payload, implements transaction commit logic via service.

classes.name: ThrowOperation
classes.description: Represents a commit operation that throws an exception, used to test fault scenarios.

methods.name: Pass
methods.description: Simulates a successful transaction commit, logs info, delays, and returns true.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Simulates a failed transaction commit, logs info, delays, and returns false.

methods.name: Throw
methods.description: Simulates an exception during transaction commit, logs info, delays, and throws ApplicationException.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Performs the commit operation by calling the corresponding method on the service, depending on the operation type.
